messages:
Sam Nguyen: FYI FinEdge (Dedicated) reporting spikes of 401s on auth endpoint since 08:12 UTC. Customer says webhooks failing, several timeouts. Ticket #FE-487.
Jon Patel: They're on an enterprise plan + committed Dedicated. This is revenue-impacting and they're asking for a deploy window ASAP.
Ada Chen: Marking P1. Sam, can you paste latest error lines and whether it's reproducible in staging? Also, what's their traffic volume right now?
Sam Nguyen: Logs show repeated "token_validation_failed" from token service. Hit rate ~120 rps, 95th latency 250ms.
Priya Rao: Copy. Could be token cache eviction with the Dedicated KV cache. Can you attach a sample trace? Also need model version and runtime SHA.
Sam Nguyen: Attached snippet:
```
[auth] 2026-03-19T08:13:02Z token_validation_failed user_id=fe_1023 session_id=abc123 cache_miss=true
```
Runtime: r-inference@v2026-03-11, runtime-sha: d4c3b2a
Jon Patel: Customer says they started higher load after bulk sync at 08:00.
Priya Rao: Two paths: 1) emergency hotfix to tighten cache TTL and add a defensive fallback to stable token backend; 2) schedule into next patch release (3-5 days). Hotfix will need a quick canary + rollback plan.
Marco Silva: If we do hotfix, we can push a canary to 2 Dedicated nodes in us-west-2 for 30m, monitor auth errors + 5xxs. Need approvals from security (for token changes) and CS for comms.
Lina Torres: I'll draft a customer note: initial acknowledgement + ETA for mitigation. Should we offer temporary config change? (reduce concurrency per-tenant)
Ada Chen: Prioritize by impact and effort. Priya, estimate engineering time for hotfix (incl. testing + canary) and risk level.
Priya Rao: Estimate 6-8 dev-hours (including tests) + 1h canary + 1h rollback prep. Risk: medium (touches auth path). Suggest feature-flagged rollout.
Sam Nguyen: Customer asked for timeline; can we say ~8 hours for mitigation if approved? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Marco Silva: Ops: schedule canary in next 90m if eng ready. I'll prepare runbook and canary dashboard (auth_error_rate, 5xx_rate, latency p95).
Ada Chen: Decision: go for hotfix canary. Priya, please submit PR with feature flag targeting dedicated pool only. Marco, coordinate canary and final deploy window. Lina, send acknowledgement to FinEdge with targeted mitigation ETA ~8h.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary-deploy/2000123456-finedge-hotfix -> started on us-west-2 nodes (2/2)
Jon Patel: I'll keep FinEdge sales contact updated and confirm SOW compensation conversation if this stretches.
Priya Rao: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8421 - includes TTL change + fallback. Tests: unit + staging replay.
Marco Silva: Canary metrics look good after 20m: auth_error_rate down from 3.1% -> 0.2%. No increase in 5xx. Proceeding to full pool rollout in 30m unless objections.
Ada Chen: +1 proceed. Lina send comms that we are rolling and will follow up with postmortem.
Lina Torres: Sent ack to customer, included monitoring screenshots and expected follow-up in 48h.
Priya Rao: Rollout complete. Deploy ID: deploy/2000123456-1. Rolling back plan standby if anything shows.
Sam Nguyen: Customer confirms services back to normal. Thanks team :pray: 
Marco Silva: Closing thread - will open incident postmortem if error resurfaces.
